Sample office files used by the parser tests.

Made for this project with Apache OpenOffice 4, from a source of known content:
  sample.odt   a title, three headings, a bulleted and a numbered list, a 3x3 table, bold, italic, a link, accents
  sample.ods   two sheets (Shows, Notes): text, numbers, an empty cell, accents, a SUM formula, an empty row

Taken unchanged from the test data of Apache POI (https://github.com/apache/poi, folder test-data),
distributed under the Apache License 2.0:
  SampleDoc.docx           seven plain paragraphs over two pages
  heading123.docx          headings at three levels, two body paragraphs
  Numbering.docx           numbered lists over several levels
  TestTableCellAlign.docx  one table of two rows and two columns
  SampleSS.xlsx            three sheets: text, numbers, formulas, styled cells
